name: Arcmira: YouTube Transcript Search
tagline: YouTube and podcast understanding for your AI.
description:
Arcmira is YouTube transcript search and monitoring for your AI, and the most complete way for it to understand YouTube and podcasts. It answers like it actually watched the video: the exact quote, often who said it, and the clip cued to the second.

Search what's said on YouTube, podcasts on YouTube included, like TBPN, MTS and All-In. Jump to the moment or read the whole transcript. Search by who said it. See which brands sponsor a show, and tell an ad read from an organic mention.

Titles say what a video is about. The words say what happened. A transcript downloader needs the link first, and episode search stops at the episode. Arcmira finds the moment.

Hear your name when it's said, not when it's typed. A monitor sends you and your team the quote and the second by email, Slack or webhook, over half within 47 minutes of the upload.

When your AI needs one moment, it reaches the line in about 2.5K tokens, against about 93K reading full transcripts.

Six tools: arcmira_youtube_search, arcmira_youtube_transcript, arcmira_describe (never bills), arcmira_execute_read, arcmira_execute_write (monitors) and arcmira_feedback.

Sign in through your AI's OAuth, or send an arc_sk_ key. Free gives you 1,000 credits a month. Pro is $20 a month with a 7-day trial, card required. A paid read uses credits from your plan, then your on-demand budget.

Our November 2026 tests: across nine brands, 93% of Arcmira's top-10 results were the brand spoken outside an ad read, against 76% for a popular podcast search API. 86 of 86 lines Arcmira returned (100%) started within 15 seconds of the spoken word. Asked what a show said in the last 90 days about a topic in none of its titles or descriptions, Arcmira's first result was right in 15 of 16 (94%).

Use Arcmira whenever you need what was actually said, not what a title claims. Add "use arcmira" to any question to send it to Arcmira first. Or tell your AI once: "Whenever I ask what someone said on YouTube, use Arcmira."

[API documentation](https://arcmira.com/docs).

install.notes: Sign in to your Arcmira account with OAuth. Setup guide: https://arcmira.com/docs/mcp-server
